description: The mutual funds purchase information endpoint provides detailed purchasing details for global mutual funds. It returns data on minimum investment requirements, current pricing, and a list of brokerages where the mutual fund can be purchased. This endpoint is useful for users looking to understand the entry requirements and options available for investing in specific mutual funds.
